releases.changelog:
MyInsta V27 beta 1

- Updated to Instagram 447.0.0.55.81 with Instagram and MyInsta clone builds for ARM64, ARM32, x86 and x86_64.
- Redesigned settings with search, grouped controls and light/dark themes.
- Ghost Mode controls for activity, receipts, Stories, screenshots and secret voice playback.
- Manual conversation read action and Seen after reply, with separate handling of view-once media.
- Download Center for posts, carousels, Reels, Stories, profile photos and supported DM media, including voice messages.
- Optional advanced Story downloads, best-available quality selection, folder settings and completion/failure notifications.
- Independent ad, distraction, gesture, autoplay, Story looping and highlight controls.
- Story mentions, exact timestamps, highlight-cover viewing and profile-photo zoom/download tools.
- Text selection, profile biography copying and four-state relationship indicators.
- Developer tools, experiment import/export and preserved community roles.
- Owner-controlled update and membership feeds; updates match the installed package, architecture and selected release channel.

Beta release: device validation is ongoing. Please report the architecture, app variant and reproduction steps with any issue.
